title: astracantha parnassi subsp. calabrica
intro: Astracantha parnassi subsp. calabrica, commonly known as Astragalus calabricus, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus calabricus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties. The plant is also used to reduce stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system, making it a valuable medicinal resource in traditional medicine.
